displayName: OCI-EXECUTION-146: SQL Command Execution via Web App
description:
Detect SQL injection leading to xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, COPY commands

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: sql command execution via web app

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_execution_execution_146", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%sql%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%command%') AND "value" > 0
